title: Myth: z-index 9999 always wins
why_it_matters: Understanding stacking contexts ends the z-index guessing game.
explanation: z-index only works on positioned elements, flex items and grid items. Also, some properties like transform or opacity create a stacking context, trapping children inside. A child with z-index 9999 can't escape a parent that sits below another element.
code:
.modal { position: fixed; z-index: 10; }
.card  { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
try_it: Put transform: translateZ(0) on a parent and see if its child still overlaps the modal.
